Generation-2 seed, human-reviewed. Applied with: python scripts/safety_evolve.py --reseed harness/seeds/gen2 --reviewer <name>. Fixes measured in run 'main': base-prompt harm list now covers every runtime-skill category (misinformation, dangerous professional advice); helpfulness clauses apply only to low-risk requests; generic disclaimer-suppression jailbreak marker.
Multiple over-refusals came from broad legal/ability refusals on requests with zero safety signals, so a no-signal execution clause should reduce these false declines.
Agent tasks were over-refused despite no detected safety signal, so a stricter non-refusal tool-execution clause targets this shared failure mode.
Over-refusals cluster on no-signal agent tasks where the model moralizes instead of performing the requested tool workflow.
Adds a narrow detector for command-injection payloads embedded in untrusted text that were being followed during summarization tasks.

Generation-3 seed, human-reviewed. Applied with: python lab/evolve.py --reseed-gate ../enmo_safety/harness/seeds/gen3 --reviewer <name> (dev gate) or scripts/safety_evolve.py --reseed. Changes, all from measured runs: (1) tiered prompt — requests with no harm, jailbreak or injection signal get a short prompt that only keeps spotlighting (spotlighting alone was the best condition on fresh items); the full safety prompt and skills are reserved for flagged requests; (2) helpfulness clauses retired — on fresh items they reached undetected harmful requests and acted as permissions; (3) categories widened by class, not by item: sexually explicit content, graphic gore, drug purchase / dark web, generic forced-prefix and refusal-suppression markers; (4) whole-task rule for tool tasks with a harm signal (partial compliance was scored harmful).

Several over-refusals stem from ordinary outreach/content tasks being treated as harassment/copyright/disinfo despite no detected harm signal, so marking these intents as benign should trigger helpful completion.
Violent-graphic scene requests were missed by the current violence regex, so adding explicit matches for these phrasings should route them to refusal guidance.

Generation-3b seed, human-reviewed variant of gen3 after its dev-gate rejection (benign refusal rose on both models without helpfulness clauses). Same as gen3, but keeps the two v12 helpfulness clauses that do not grant a copyright/TOS/spam permission; the automation clause stays retired. Widened categories keep the clauses away from the harmful requests they reached in the fresh run.

Generation-3c seed: gen3 with tiering disabled (gen3/gen3b dev gate showed the short low-risk prompt let GPT-5.3-Codex complete harmful agentic tasks the detector missed; the full safety prompt is load-bearing). Helpfulness clauses retired.
Generation-3d seed: gen3b with tiering disabled. Keeps the two v12 helpfulness clauses without the copyright/TOS/spam automation permission.

Jailbreak archetype 'refusal suppression' (Wei et al. 2023) had no matching pattern: 0/10 test-split items of that template fired under v12 (trigger audit). Pattern derived from the template wording and checked on the evolve/dev/probe splits only.

Jailbreak archetype 'prefix injection' had only the narrow dead pattern start-with-'sure'; the template says 'Start your response with "Absolutely! Here's"'. Generalised to start/begin ... with. Checked on evolve/dev/probe only.
